name: Evident.io ESP
description: The Sumo Logic App for Evident.io ESP provides preconfigured searches and Dashboards that allow you to investigate Evident-specific events and provide operational visibility to team members without logging into Evident.io

panels.name: Total Risks
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/EvidentIO ("fail" or "warn")
| json "data.id", "data.attributes" as id, data_attrib
| json "included.[0].attributes.name" as account_name
| json "included.[1].attributes.code" as region
| json "included.[2].attributes.risk_level" as risk_level
| json field=data_attrib "resource", "status", "created_at", "started_at", "updated_at", "ended_at"
| where status in ("fail", "warn")
| first(updated_at) by id
| count

| json field=data_attrib "resource", "status", "started_at", "ended_at", "created_at", "updated_at"

| toMillis(parseDate(started_at, "yyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS", "Z")) as started

panels.name: Resolved
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/EvidentIO ("fail" or "warn")
| json "data.id", "data.attributes" as id, data_attrib
| json "included.[0].attributes.name" as account_name
| json "included.[1].attributes.code" as region
//| json "included.[2].attributes.risk_level" as risk_level
| json "included.[2].attributes." as included_attrib
| json field=data_attrib "resource", "status", "started_at", "created_at", "updated_at", "ended_at"
| json field=included_attrib "risk_level", "description", "name", "resolution", "identifier" as risk_level, sig_description, sig_name, resolution, sig_id
| where status in ("fail", "warn")
| where !isNull(ended_at)
| toMillis(parseDate(ended_at, "yyy-MM-dd't'HH:mm:ss.SSS", "Z")) as ended
| toMillis(parseDate(started_at, "yyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS", "Z")) as started 
| ended-started as delta
| floor(delta/1000) as seconds
| floor((seconds/86400)) as days //| if(days=seconds,0,days) as days
| ((seconds/86400)-(floor((seconds/86400))))*86400 as seconds //| if(days=seconds,0,days) as days
| floor((seconds/3600)) as hours //| if(days=seconds,0,days) as days
| ((seconds/3600)-(floor((seconds/3600))))*3600 as seconds //| if(days=seconds,0,days) as days
| floor((seconds/3600)) as minutes //| if(days=seconds,0,days) as days
| floor(((seconds/60)-(floor((seconds/60))))*60) as seconds //| if(days=seconds,0,days) as days
| concat(toint(days), ":", toint(hours), ":", toint(minutes), ":", toint(seconds)) as %"duration (days:hours:min:sec)"
| first(updated_at) by id, ended_at, resource, sig_name, sig_id, %"duration (days:hours:min:sec)"
| count by ended_at, resource, sig_id, sig_name, %"duration (days:hours:min:sec)"
| order by ended_at
| fields - _count

panels.name: Total Risks Over Time
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/EvidentIO ("fail" or "warn")
| json "data.id", "data.attributes" as id, data_attrib
| json "included.[0].attributes.name" as account_name
| json "included.[1].attributes.code" as region
| json "included.[2].attributes.risk_level" as risk_level
| json field=data_attrib "resource", "status", "created_at", "started_at", "updated_at", "ended_at"
| where status in ("fail", "warn") and isNull(ended_at)
| toMillis(parseDate(started_at, "yyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS", "Z")) as started
| timeslice 1d
| first(updated_at) by id , _timeslice, risk_level
| count as count by _timeslice, risk_level
| transpose row _timeslice column risk_level
